rows.Name: Trial of Intelligence
rows.SourceText: Find Idena Blaimmel west of your trainer, around the corner in Aegirhamn, and hear her riddle.|||
rows.StepText: Find Idena Blaimmel west of your trainer, around the corner in Aegirhamn, and hear her riddle.|Idena's riddle names the marine fungus: kill one in the waters south of Aegirhamn and take its leg.|She wants TWO legs: kill a second marine fungus.|Return to Idena and hand her both legs.

rows.Name: Information / Trickery
rows.Description: Three Drakoran border watchers each carry a scroll with [information] I want. And one of the ladies here needs the essence of a corpse candle.

rows.Name: Solving the Argument
rows.Description: I give up! These two are [driving me crazy]!
rows.SourceText: I hope for both my sanity and their health that you have found Alisa's and Olvaerr's missing items, <Player>. Do I see [a cloak] in your pack there?||||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Kaisa in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell.|Get a pelt from a mammoth calf.|Get a morvalt sinew from a morvalt ungdom.|Get some essence from a pysling.|Get an eye from a biting insect.|Return to Kaisa in Dyrfjell.|Go and see Skorri again.
rows.TargetText: Come in, come in, <Player>. If I'm not mistaken, Skorri sent you to me. I could hear Ailsa and Olvaerr all the way over here. They have been fighting for days and poor Skorri has been close to tears, which is saying something, him being a troll. They have surely tested his patience. I am just glad that I saw both objects before those two addle-brains [lost them]. Yes, they lost them. A few days ago Ailsa went out with the totem tied to her belt and didn't come back with it. I'm sure she lost it when she was out studying the Morvaltar for <Player>. As for Olvaerr, Ailsa might be right in hat he lost it in a drinking game [with the dwarves]. He took a horse to Aegirhamn on the same say that Ailsa went out and he returned the next morning, reeking for ale and groaning about his head. I didn't see the cloak anywhere. It was the same day they both started accusing the other of stealing. I'm just glad I saw both items before they lost them Poor Skorri only has a certain amount of time [to meet Stonelock] up in Gripklosa mountains and if he can't get those two groups moving, Stonelock will be furious. Stonelock is going to be leading an expedition into the wilds of Gripklosa to track down the truth of yet another rumor about the Troll Fathers. I told Skorri to just go himself and leave both groups here and let <Player> and Longbeard get in trouble for not being able to control their people, but Skorri said Stonelock wouldn't look at it that was. I'd hate for Skorri to [get in trouble] since he's been so kind to check on me while I've been sick. Well, if we want to keep Skorri out of trouble, we better get you going! Olvaerr's cloak is rather easy to reproduce. From what he was telling anyone who would listen, he killed a mammoth bull himself and sewed it with he sinew from a morvalt bagskytt. But I saw the cloak and know the pelt actually came from a mammoth calf. And I heard Alisa say she saw Olvaerr killing a morvalt ungdom shortly before he started wearing the cloak. I think you can handle getting the pelt and the sinew. Now for [Ailsa's totem]. This will be a bit more difficult. She took the eye of a biting insect and imbued it with the essence of a pyslings. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. Do you [need directions] to the creatures or do you [know the way]?{next}The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Watch out for the young mammoths, they are more than you can handle at this point! For the morvalt ungdom, follow the road southwest as if you are going to Aegirhamn and cross the large stone bridge. Not far over the bridge you will find morvalt ungdom on both sides of the road. The pyslings and found in many places, but I like one particular spot. From the guard tower near the large stone bridge, head due south. You'll cross over the road and enter a small valley between the hills. You should find some in there. Some are only there at night, but others are there all the time. As for the biting insects, head south from the guard tower near the large stone bridge. Cross over the road and into a small valley between the hills. Once in the valley, follow it west until you reach the beach. The biting insects live along the coastline. Oh, <Player>, you should be thankful you were not here recently! Ails and Olvaerr got into another yelling match and Skorri was ready to drag them back to Muspelheim and drop them into the lava! I managed to get over there and calm them down. Poor Skorri! He's looking so tired from all this. Let us get these things made quickly, shall we? I need the pelt from the mammoth calf first.|||||Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak. There, that is done and it looks exactly the same as the one he had before. Good job <Player>! Now give me the essence from the pyslings. Please give me the eye from the biting insect. That is done too. I was a little unsure of this one, but from what I overheard Ailsa saying, this is the same process she used. We'll see if it's acceptable to her or not. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!|
rows.FinishText: According to Stonelock, this was made by the finest Troll craftspeople around. I hope you will use it as you explore this land. Perhaps one day we shall speak again and you can join in an expedition I am leading! May the house of Skadi watch over you, <Player>!

Once in the valley, follow it west until you reach the beach. The biting insects live along the coastline. Oh, <Player>, you should be thankful you were not here recently! Ails and Olvaerr got into another yelling match and Skorri was ready to drag them back to Muspelheim and drop them into the lava! I managed to get over there and calm them down. Poor Skorri! He's looking so tired from all this. Let us get these things made quickly, shall we? I need the pelt from the mammoth calf first.|||||Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!|

rows.Name: Kyllikki's Scrolls
rows.Description: Can you feel it? Can you feel the magic that flows through this land from the great mother of Morvaltar? At time I think I can fell it, but it still eludes me. If only I could touch that power for just an instant, I know I could [harness it and use it]! Then my enemies, ah, the enemies of Midgard would cower in the fear before me, er, the armies of King Goran!
rows.SourceText: Kyllikki has the scrolls hidden in the house she lives in. It is up to you to figure out a way to get them. I've asked her for them before but she refused, but again, I think it is because she does not like me. You could try that if you wanted, or you could try [getting them out] of her house yourself.|
rows.StepText: Talk to Kyllikki in her house west of Catla over the bridge and tell her you seek the [scrolls of magic].|Take the scrolls to Catla in Aegirhamn.
rows.TargetText: Hello there. Is there something I can do for you?{next}You want my scrolls do you? Well, they are not for just anyone! They contain information about powerful magic that has been used by my people since the dawn of time. It is not for the weak or fearful! I'm guessing someone told you I had these scrolls and sent you to get them. What I wonder is who sent you. I have a guess, but I wonder, whom are you getting them for? Perhaps you should tell me before we go any farther.{next}Why don't I believe you? Foolish being, return to Catla! She will have to continue her study of Morvaltar magic on her own. I will not help her anymore. Go back to her now and tell her I would not give you the scrolls. If she wishes to have them, she should have come herself!|
rows.FinishText: You destroyed them? How? The only way to destroy them is to use them! By Hel and all the other gods of Midgard, I told you not to use them! Do you not listen? And now I bet you expect me to give you a reward? Hah! You?re lucky, because I have found a Valkyn who will tell me more about the mother. Here take this; I don?t want it. Do not let it be said that Catla doesn't fulfill her promises.
